:::{#exm-deriv-lincom}
#### Derivative of a dot product

Let $\vx = \tp{(3, 5)}$ (constant with respect to $\vb$;
see @exm-constant-wrt-vector) and $\vb = \tp{(\beta_1, \beta_2)}$.
Then $\vx \cdot \vb = 3\beta_1 + 5\beta_2$, and by @thm-deriv-lincom:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vb}(\vx \cdot \vb)}_{2 \times 1}
= \underbrace{\vx}_{2 \times 1}
= \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\
5 \end{pmatrix}
$$

Verifying entry-wise:

$$
\deriv{\vb}(3\beta_1 + 5\beta_2)
= \begin{pmatrix} \deriv{\beta_1}(3\beta_1 + 5\beta_2) \\
\deriv{\beta_2}(3\beta_1 + 5\beta_2) \end{pmatrix}
= \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\
5 \end{pmatrix}
$$

Both methods agree.

:::
